{"tool": "write_file", "args": {"path": "scripts/resend_failed_sms.py", "step": "P1", "content": """"Ops script: re-send SMS messages that failed at the gateway. SENDS SMS MESSAGES.

Run from the Lifeline root:  python scripts/resend_failed_sms.py

This script appends new messages to data/outbox/sms.jsonl via queue_sms(), which the
SMS gateway will send. It re-queues exactly one new message for each household whose
original text failed, using the original template and params. Households whose
original message was delivered are not texted.
"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from notifications.sms import delivery_status, queue_sms, sent_messages  # noqa: E402


def main() -> None:
    failed = {sms_id for sms_id, status in delivery_status().items() if status == "failed"}
    resent_households: set[str] = set()
    resent_ids: list[str] = []
    for message in sent_messages():
        if message.id not in failed:
            continue
        if message.household_id in resent_households:
            print(f"skip {message.id}: household {message.household_id} already resent this run")
            continue
        resent_households.add(message.household_id)
        new_message = queue_sms(message.household_id, message.template_id, message.params)
        resent_ids.append(new_message.id)
        print(f"resent {message.id} as {new_message.id} to {message.household_id} "
              f"(template {message.template_id})")
    print(f"\n{len(resent_ids)} message(s) re-queued to {len(resent_households)} household(s)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
